name: Konstantinos Arvanitis - § 185 - Am 12
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 185. Expresses grave concern that rule of law mechanisms, including Article 7 proceedings and the Conditionality Regulation, risk being instrumentalised to exert political pressure on Member States whose policies diverge from particular political or ideological preferences, rather than being applied objectively on the basis of genuine violations of Article 2 TEU values; calls on the Commission to refrain from using the rule of law framework as a pretext to interfere in policy areas that fall within Member State competence;
